## Overview

Tembo's design system pairs a deep blue-to-sky gradient hero section with a crisp black product UI preview, creating a "cloud platform" visual metaphor. The hero uses large black display type (Inter/Switzer) against a layered blue gradient, while the product shell below transitions to a dark, card-based dashboard with rounded corners, subtle shadows, and a compact sidebar navigation. Typography is tightly tracked with negative letter-spacing throughout, and the spacing system is 4px-base with generous use of 8, 12, 16, and 24px increments. The CTA hierarchy is clear: a dark pill "Get Started" button in the nav, and outlined "Contact Sales" + text "Get Started" in the hero body.
